title: Chapter 309 Unification Of The World
content:
Chapter 309 Unification Of The World

"It's time, after being silent for so long, I finally show my fangs to the world again!"

Standing up on the throne, Zhong Yu drew out the long sword in his hand, pointed to the south facing the entrance of the hall, his eyes were far away.

After gazing for a while, he withdrew his gaze, lowered his head, and looked at the civil and military ministers in two rows below. There were hundreds of people gathered in the hall.

"I ordered to gather the army and go south to the Central Plains after 3 months. This time I want to conquer the kingdoms and rule the world!" Zhong Yulang shouted, his tone full of indisputability.

"Your servant obeys your orders!" Under the seat, hundreds of people cheered and bowed down to salute.

Afterwards, when these ministers left, all departments of the entire imperial kingdom began to operate rapidly. Driven by them, Yuguo became a war machine, countless resources were directed towards war, and countless armies quickly assembled and gathered in Liaodong County.

It has been eight years since Zhong Yu provoked the second Hezhong alliance to attack Qi. It has been 14 years since Yuguo came to this world and formulated a strategy of disrupting the Central Plains, accumulating strength in the rear, and then capturing the Central Plains with absolute strength.

For such a long time, it has been almost a generation. After such a long period of reproduction, Yuguo has completely digested the territory and population it captured before, and has grown the country's population to about 7 million.

Correspondingly, Yuguo also has an army of 800,000, of which 400,000 are elite.

In addition, Yu Kingdom also has a guard army with a population of about 200,000, all of which have internal strength. They are usually stationed in the imperial capital of Liaoning to guard the safety of the imperial capital.

In this way, an army of one million has been formed. Yu Country is also the owner of fine soldiers and food, and has the background and strength to launch a million-scale war.

On the contrary, all over the Central Plains. With the successive years of wars, the population has been greatly reduced, especially the young and mature, and there are very few.

Originally, there were still 30 million people in all countries before the war. But now after this series of wars, it has dropped sharply to only about 8 million. It is only comparable to the population of Yuguo, and it is not as strong as it is.

Moreover, the total number of soldiers and horses of all countries is less than one million, and there are only about 600,000 left, which is even more difficult to resist the country's aggression.

Under such circumstances, with such a good advantage in strength, when will Yuguo not annex the Central Plains?

After March, the Imperial Kingdom assembled an army of 600,000, leaving only some troops in the mainland to maintain law and order.

In the 15th year of Emperor Yuan, March.

Just after the spring plowing was over, the imperial army came out in full force, attacking the eight southern countries, and began his great cause of dominating the world.

Soon, under the internal support of the upper and lower courts of the Yan Kingdom, the defenders of the cities of the Yan Kingdom opened their cities and surrendered one after another. Within ten days, Yan State perished. The reason why it took so long was because the army was on their way.

After that, the 600,000 army was divided into two groups, 300,000 attacked Zhao, and 300,000 attacked Qi.

The whole territory of Zhao State was unable to resist, and many important towns were captured. Although Zhao Wang organized many resistances, it was difficult to resist the mighty strength of the national army. After three months, it was also destroyed.

Qi State was weaker than Zhao State, but it only persisted for two months before being destroyed.

When the other five kingdoms heard that the royal kingdom was going south and that the three kingdoms would be destroyed within a short period of time, they were terrified and determined to unite together to resist.

However, there is a huge gap between the countries, and both sides have deep-seated hatred, and it is difficult to believe that the other party intends to form an alliance.

The alliance has just been mentioned, and the countries have been wrangling for a while. Because of the distribution of benefits, it is difficult to reach an agreement, so it is invalidated.

Subsequently, the Han and Wei countries, which were located in the hinterland of the Central Plains and blocked the Yuguo's iron hooves from going south, were the first to bear the brunt, and were attacked by Yuguo's 500,000 troops without accident.

During this period, the imperial concubine of Yuguo, Princess Honglian of South Korea, once asked the emperor of Yuguo to let Korea go, but was ruthlessly refused. As a result, the husband and wife who had a harmonious relationship gradually developed a rift, which is not as good as before.

The two countries of Han and Wei resisted for a month, and then they were destroyed by the army, following the fate of Yanzhao and other countries.

Subsequently, in addition to the lost 100,000 of the 600,000 army, another 200,000 were left to guard the old places of the Five Kingdoms to prevent accidents.

The remaining 300,000 troops all attacked Chu State. As for Qin State and Yue State, they were temporarily put aside and did not attack them.

The state of Chu has a vast territory, with inconvenient roads and many water systems. It is an unrealistic idea to want to destroy Chu State quickly.

Therefore, the 300,000 Southern Expedition Army fought steadily, one county at a time, and slowly encroached on the territory of Chu State

During the period of the Chu State, several resistances were organized, and the number of troops even reached 200,000 at one time, but in the end they lost to the elite imperial guards and were quickly defeated.

Afterwards, the state of Chu fell into a complete decline, and could only sit back and watch its territory be gradually invaded, relying on the vastness of the territory to delay its own demise.

Within three months of attacking Chu State, Nanyang County, Jiujiang County, and Hengshan County of Chu State were destroyed.

In April, Lujiang County was broken.

In May, Nanjun was broken, and Changsha County fell into war.

In June, Changsha County fell completely, and the king of Chu moved his capital to Qianzhong County to continue to resist.

In August, Qianzhong County was lost, and the King of Chu retreated to Yelang County.

In September, the local chief of Yelang County killed the king of Chu, and the state of Chu was destroyed.

In this long war, the 300,000 Chu army lost more than 100,000, and the rest could barely garrison the old place of Chu, unable to attack the other two countries.

At the same time, the 15th year of Emperor Yuan is slowly coming to an end, and the 16th year of Emperor Yuan is ushered in.

As soon as the new year came, Yuguo mainland once again mobilized 300,000 troops to attack the southern Yueguo.

There are only 60,000 soldiers in the country of Yue, how can they resist, but in March, even if they rely on the vast land and complex terrain to delay, it is difficult to stop the fate of extinction for a while, and they are completely crushed by the iron cavalry of the imperial country.

So far, all the countries east of Hangu Pass have been wiped out by the Yu Kingdom, leaving only the Qin State in the west, which still occupies the Guanzhong and Bashu lands.

However, although the strength of Qin State is not weak, there are 200,000 soldiers in the whole country. But these soldiers have to stay in various places, and only 100,000 people can really be drawn out. Facing the next hundreds of thousands of troops from Yu Kingdom, it is determined to be difficult to resist.

July.

The 600,000 troops of the Imperial Kingdom sent troops, divided into five groups to attack the Qin State, and the Qin State also raised 100,000 troops to resist.

In the first month of the Mi War, the Qin State was unable to resist, and the northern and eastern barriers, Shangjun and Hedong Commanderies were lost. Neishi County, where the capital is located, was attacked by hundreds of thousands of troops, and Xianyang was in danger.

In September, after losing all barriers, Xianyang City resisted for some time, and then fell. The king of Qin moved his capital to Chengdu, the land of Bashu in the south, and all parts of Guanzhong fell into war.

In October, the counties in Guanzhong were destroyed, and the forces of Qin State completely shrank the three counties of Bashu.

In the 17th year of Emperor Yuan, March.

Under the attack of Yuguo's army, Hanzhong County persisted for three months by virtue of the mountain's danger, but finally couldn't resist and fell into Yuguo's hands.

In May, 300,000 imperial troops invaded the land of Bashu.

In June, Berkshire fell.

In July, Shu County fell, Qin Wang Yingzheng committed suicide by destroying the city, and Qin State fell.

With the demise of Qin, the world was finally unified. The land that has been in chaos for thousands of years has finally ushered in its only owner and true peace.

Zhong Yu, it's time to leave this place that bored him, and look for a powerful world that can solve the curse on him.

After writing for so long, with more than two hundred pages of content, Qin Shimingyue's chapter is finally over. After such a long time, the author has gradually discovered many shortcomings. Especially in the later period, the more than 20 chapters are a bit boring, and it is a bit suspected of the number of words on the assembly line. So now we can only speed up the progress to end this world, I believe everyone will be a little annoying watching it.

The next world is the Warring States Period of Japan. It is a world where gods and demons dance wildly, and ghosts and ghosts are rampant. It is also in a chaotic world full of wars. I have wanted to write about this world for a long time, but the world I wrote before was all in the background of China, so I couldn’t let go. Now change to the Japanese background, I want to write about the evil in my heart, and fully reflect the tyranny of the protagonist there.
